title: The Long Letter
author: Odile Okonkwo
blurb: Casper Okonkwo, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
